Based on my investigation, I've identified the relevant code. Let me verify my understanding of the sorting flow once more before submitting.

The feature request asks that extra networks items (models/checkpoints/LoRAs/etc. in the "additional interfaces" tabs under txt2img/img2img) be sorted by date by default, so a newly downloaded model appears at the top.

Key findings:

1. **`modules/ui_extra_networks.py`** (line 384): The sort dropdown is created with `value='Default Sort'`, which is why the natural (alphabetical/natural-sort) order is used by default instead of a date-based order. The choices already include `'Date Created'`/`'Date Modified'`, and each card already carries `data-sort-date-created`/`data-sort-date-modified` keys (via `get_sort_keys`).

2. **`javascript/extraNetworks.js`**: The `applySort` function reads the dropdown value and re-sorts cards by the corresponding `data-sort-*` attribute, but it is only invoked on user interaction with the dropdown/sort-order button — `sort.dataset.sortkey` is initialized to `'sortDefault'` and `applySort()` is never called on load/refresh (only `applyFilter()` is). So even if the dropdown default were changed, the initial display wouldn't be date-sorted until the user interacts.

To implement "sort by date by default when opening additional interfaces", both the default dropdown value (Python) and the initial application of the sort (JavaScript) must be changed.
